preconditions.name: foraging_contact_guard
preconditions.description: 603n G2+G3: per-seed P2 contact_rate > 0 AND z_goal_norm_at_contact_peak > 0.4 on >= 2/3 seeds.

preconditions.name: commitment_and_completion_engaged
preconditions.description: the ON arm committed (total_beta_elevated > 0) AND reached completions (n_sequence_completions > 0) on >= 2/3 guard-passing seeds -- so closure HAD an opportunity to fire (the n_closures=0 *b-cohort gap, now self-routed; n_closures=0 WITHOUT completions is substrate-not-engaged, WITH completions is a genuine weakens).
preconditions.control: fraction of guard-passing seeds with ON-arm commitment AND sequence completions.

contact_guard.definition: per-seed: P2 contact_rate > 0 AND z_goal_norm_at_contact_peak > 0.4 (603n G2 + G3). < 2/3 seeds passing -> substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a false weakens.

completion_non_vacuity_gate.definition: ON-arm total_beta_elevated > 0 AND n_sequence_completions > 0 on >= 2/3 guard-passing seeds. Below floor -> substrate_not_ready_requeue (non_contributory), NEVER a false weakens (the V3-EXQ-643 / V3-EXQ-514n same-precondition lesson).
